theme: A caregiving day, with one call to Tokyo.
greeting: Most of today belongs to getting Mike through his scans and set for tomorrow's surgery, Dan. One evening call lands in Tokyo's morning, then a calm run-up to Portland.

needsAttention.title: Last items before Mike's surgery
needsAttention.detail: Oral surgery is tomorrow in Portland, so today's window is filling the prescriptions, stocking soft food, and grabbing ice packs and gauze. You're also his ride home afterward.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia on the PRI
needsAttention.detail: She offered call slots last week and hasn't heard back; the times she gave have mostly slipped by, so it's worth proposing a fresh one.

needsAttention.title: IMC research call with Chie and Mike
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow night's call is about the next stage of the research; good to arrive with a view on Chie's idea of pulling actors beyond asset managers into the stewardship conversation.

flagged.title: NACD New England reception RSVP
flagged.detail: NACD New England asked you to reply about their Sept 15 Appreciation Reception.

flagged.title: New public-policy VP role posted
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert flagged a stealth VP, Government Relations & Public Policy opening from 8/17.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley corporate action
flagged.detail: A voluntary corporate action notice is posted for your Morgan Stanley Private Markets holding.

inbox.noise: Schoolhouse, Amex, Apple Card, Midcoast Villager and a couple of newsletters — nothing that needs you.
inbox.clear: Amra wrote back warmly on the Sustainalytics question; a friendly reply when you have a minute.

recipe.title: Canal house year-round caprese salad
recipe.why: Late-summer tomatoes and basil are at their peak right now, so a caprese lets them do all the talking.

acts.line: Mike's throat ultrasound at 9:30 opens a day built around his care.
A brain MRI at 3:30 and a haircut after keep the medical run going before things ease.
An 8 o'clock Jomon call meets Tokyo's morning, then a quiet lead-in to Portland.
